title: An .htaccess file is served
summary: The web server returns its own .htaccess, which reveals rewrite rules and protected paths.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("RewriteEngine") or body_contains("Options ") or body_contains("<Directory")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block hidden files at the web server so .htaccess is never served.
